examples.sentence: This school is ranked among the best in the country.
examples.translation_zh: 这所学校在全国名列前茅。

examples.sentence: He stood quietly among the crowd at the festival.
examples.translation_zh: 他静静地站在人群中，参加节日庆典。

yet.def_en: Up to this time; until now; still not.

examples.sentence: The best part of the show is yet to come.
examples.translation_zh: 节目的最佳部分尚未到来。

examples.sentence: I have not yet finished my homework for school.
examples.translation_zh: 我还没有完成学校的作业。

examples.sentence: There is yet another report of a missing person.
examples.translation_zh: 又有一则失踪人员的报告。

ever.def_en: At any time; at all times in the past, present, or future.

examples.sentence: I have loved her ever since we met.
examples.translation_zh: 自从我们见面以来，我就一直爱着她。

examples.sentence: If ever there was a need for change, it is now.
examples.translation_zh: 如果说有任何需要改变的时刻，那就是现在。

examples.sentence: The research shows that technology is ever more important in education.
examples.translation_zh: 研究表明，技术在教育中变得越来越重要。

stand.def_en: To be in an upright position on one's feet.

examples.sentence: I always stand up when the teacher enters the room.
examples.translation_zh: 老师进教室时我总是站起来。

examples.sentence: These symbols stand for peace and unity in the world.
examples.translation_zh: 这些符号代表着世界的和平与统一。

examples.sentence: You need to stand by your team during tough times.
examples.translation_zh: 在困难时期你需要支持你的团队。

member.def_en: A person or thing that belongs to a group.

examples.sentence: Many group members shared their opinions during the discussion.
examples.translation_zh: 许多组员在讨论中分享了他们的观点。

examples.sentence: Every team member contributed to the final project.
examples.translation_zh: 每位团队成员都为最终项目做出了贡献。

examples.sentence: A club member organized the annual event last year.
examples.translation_zh: 一位社团成员去年组织了年度活动。

pay.def_en: To give money in exchange for goods or services.

examples.sentence: Students should pay attention in class for better learning.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在课堂上应该专心听讲以便更好地学习。

examples.sentence: She needs to pay the bills before the due date.
examples.translation_zh: 她需要在截止日期之前支付账单。

examples.sentence: They worked hard to pay off a loan quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 他们努力工作以尽快还清贷款。

bad.def_en: Not good; unpleasant or of poor quality.

examples.sentence: Today, the weather is much worse than bad.
examples.translation_zh: 今天的天气比坏得多。

examples.sentence: She delivered the bad news to her family yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 她昨天把坏消息告诉了家人。

examples.sentence: Making a bad decision can lead to serious problems.
examples.translation_zh: 做出糟糕的决定可能会导致严重的问题。

meet.def_en: To come together with someone by arrangement or chance.

examples.sentence: I will meet a friend at the café later.
examples.translation_zh: 我会在咖啡馆和朋友见面。

examples.sentence: Travelers often meet new people during their adventures.
examples.translation_zh: 旅行者在冒险中经常会遇到新的人。

examples.sentence: Candidates must meet requirements to apply for the job.
examples.translation_zh: 申请这份工作必须符合要求。

city.def_en: A large human settlement with buildings and infrastructure.

examples.sentence: Many people live in big cities across the world.
examples.translation_zh: 世界上有很多人住在大城市里。

examples.sentence: The city center has many shops and restaurants to explore.
examples.translation_zh: 市中心有很多商店和餐馆可以探索。

examples.sentence: Children love to play in the city parks during weekends.
examples.translation_zh: 周末，孩子们喜欢在城市公园里玩耍。

almost.def_en: Not quite; very nearly; just about.

examples.sentence: I go for a walk almost every day.
examples.translation_zh: 我几乎每天都去散步。

examples.sentence: She is almost finished with her report now.
examples.translation_zh: 她的报告现在几乎完成了。

examples.sentence: Almost all the students passed the exam this term.
examples.translation_zh: 几乎所有学生这个学期都通过了考试。

car.def_en: A road vehicle with four wheels, typically powered by an engine.

examples.sentence: She loves to drive her car every weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢每个周末开车。

examples.sentence: Many people want to buy a car for commuting to work.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人想买一辆车以便通勤。

examples.sentence: There was a serious car accident on the highway yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 昨天高速公路上发生了一起严重的车祸。

set.def_en: A collection of items or a group of things.

examples.sentence: Every team needs a set of rules to follow.
examples.translation_zh: 每个团队都需要一套规则来遵循。

examples.sentence: Students should set goals to improve their studies.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该设定目标以提高学习成绩。

examples.sentence: I will set a schedule for my daily tasks.
examples.translation_zh: 我将为我的日常任务制定一个时间表。

five.def_en: The number after four and before six.

examples.sentence: It takes five minutes to walk to the store.
examples.translation_zh: 到商店步行需要五分钟。

examples.sentence: Five countries signed the new climate agreement yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 昨天，五个国家签署了新的气候协议。

examples.sentence: There are five types of bacteria in this sample.
examples.translation_zh: 这个样本中有五种细菌。

name.def_en: A word or set of words by which a person or thing is known.

examples.sentence: My first name is Alex and it is nice.
examples.translation_zh: 我的名字是亚历克斯， 很高兴认识你。

examples.sentence: Can you please tell me your last name now?
examples.translation_zh: 你能现在告诉我你的姓吗？

examples.sentence: They are choosing a new business name for their shop.
examples.translation_zh: 他们正在为自己的商店选择一个新名称。

learn.def_en: To gain knowledge or skills through study or experience.

examples.sentence: I want to learn English to communicate better.
examples.translation_zh: 我想学习英语，以更好地沟通。

examples.sentence: Children learn how to ride a bicycle quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们很快学会骑自行车。

examples.sentence: Employees often learn from mistakes made during projects.
examples.translation_zh: 员工们经常从项目中犯的错误中学习。

once.def_en: At one time in the past; not now.

examples.sentence: I visit my grandmother once in a while.
examples.translation_zh: 我偶尔去看我的奶奶。

examples.sentence: Once upon a time, there was a brave knight.
examples.translation_zh: 从前，有一个勇敢的骑士。

examples.sentence: We meet once a week for our team discussion.
examples.translation_zh: 我们每周开一次团队讨论会。

change.def_en: To make something different from what it is.

examples.sentence: Many people want to change the world for good.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人想要改变世界，造福人类。

examples.sentence: I hope you will change your mind about this decision.
examples.translation_zh: 我希望你会改变对这个决定的看法。

examples.sentence: A sudden change in the weather surprised everyone today.
examples.translation_zh: 今天天气的突然变化让每个人都感到惊讶。

white.def_en: The color of milk or fresh snow; light in color.

examples.sentence: Researchers published a white paper on climate change solutions.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员发布了一份关于气候变化解决方案的白皮书。

examples.sentence: Doctors tested the patient's white blood cells for infection.
examples.translation_zh: 医生检测了病人的白血球以确认感染。

examples.sentence: The soldier raised a white flag to show surrender.
examples.translation_zh: 士兵举起白旗表示投降。

several.def_en: More than two but not many; a few.

examples.sentence: You can choose between several options for dinner tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 今晚，你可以选择几个晚餐选项。

examples.sentence: Several studies show the benefits of regular exercise.
examples.translation_zh: 几项研究显示规律锻炼的好处。

examples.sentence: There are several reasons why we should change our strategy.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该改变策略，有几个原因。

idea.def_en: A thought or suggestion about a possible course of action.

examples.sentence: You have a good idea for the party theme.
examples.translation_zh: 你对派对主题有个好想法。

examples.sentence: Our team needs a new idea to improve sales.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队需要一个新想法来提高销售。

examples.sentence: It is a great idea to study in groups.
examples.translation_zh: 在小组中学习是个好主意。

minute.def_en: A unit of time equal to sixty seconds.

examples.sentence: The minute hand moves faster than the hour hand.
examples.translation_zh: 分针比时针移动得快。

examples.sentence: Every minute counts in emergency situations like this one.
examples.translation_zh: 在这种紧急情况下，每一分钟都很重要。

examples.sentence: Wait a few minutes before you start the test.
examples.translation_zh: 在开始考试前，请等几分钟。

body.def_en: The physical structure of a human or animal.

examples.sentence: Doctors study how the human body works every day.
examples.translation_zh: 医生每天研究人体的运作方式。

examples.sentence: Understanding body language can improve your communication skills.
examples.translation_zh: 理解肢体语言可以提高你的沟通技巧。

examples.sentence: She has a significant body of work in environmental science.
examples.translation_zh: 她在环境科学方面有着重要的研究成果。

ago.def_en: In the past; a specified time before now.

examples.sentence: I met her at the park two days ago.
examples.translation_zh: 我在两天前的公园遇见了她。

examples.sentence: The event happened a week ago and was covered widely.
examples.translation_zh: 这个事件在一周前发生，并得到了广泛报道。

examples.sentence: Many legends were told long ago in ancient times.
examples.translation_zh: 许多传说在古代很久以前就被讲述。

understand.def_en: Perceive the meaning or significance of something.

examples.sentence: We need to understand the problem before finding a solution.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要理解这个问题，然后再寻找解决方案。

examples.sentence: I finally understand what you mean about the movie.
examples.translation_zh: 我终于理解你对那部电影的意思了。

examples.sentence: Students must understand the rules of the game before playing.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们必须理解游戏的规则后才能开始玩。

whether.def_en: Indicates choices or possibilities between options.

examples.sentence: I can't decide whether or not to go today.
examples.translation_zh: 我无法决定今天是否去。

examples.sentence: Whether it's true or false, we need to check.
examples.translation_zh: 无论这是否真实，我们需要核实。

examples.sentence: Teachers want to know whether they will pass the test.
examples.translation_zh: 老师想知道他们是否会通过考试。

together.def_en: In one place or at the same time; in a group.

examples.sentence: Many teams need to work together for success.
examples.translation_zh: 许多团队需要一起合作才能成功。

examples.sentence: They often come together to celebrate special events.
examples.translation_zh: 他们经常一起庆祝特别的活动。

examples.sentence: Some families choose to live together for support.
examples.translation_zh: 一些家庭选择一起生活以获得支持。

nothing.def_en: Not anything; no single object or person exists.

examples.sentence: You have nothing to worry about in this situation.
examples.translation_zh: 在这种情况下，你没有什么好担心的。

examples.sentence: Nothing can stop us from achieving our goals this year.
examples.translation_zh: 今年没有什么能阻止我们实现目标。

examples.sentence: There is nothing new in today’s reports on the economy.
examples.translation_zh: 今天关于经济的报道没有什么新内容。

watch.def_en: A device to tell time or the act of observing something.

examples.sentence: I want to watch a movie this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我想在这个周末看一部电影。

examples.sentence: They watch the news every evening for updates.
examples.translation_zh: 他们每天晚上看新闻以获取最新消息。

examples.sentence: Please watch your step when entering the building.
examples.translation_zh: 请在进入大楼时注意你的脚步。

face.def_en: The front part of a person's head.

examples.sentence: Many employees face challenges every day at work.
examples.translation_zh: 许多员工每天在工作中面临挑战。

examples.sentence: You must face the truth about your situation.
examples.translation_zh: 你必须面对关于自己情况的真相。

examples.sentence: Students often face difficulties when learning new topics.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在学习新课题时经常面临困难。

information.def_en: Facts or details about a subject or topic.

examples.sentence: I often receive information from my friends online.
examples.translation_zh: 我经常从我的朋友那里收到信息。

examples.sentence: We need to share information to complete the project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要共享信息以完成项目。

examples.sentence: Students can access information from various online sources.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以从各种在线来源获取信息。

parent.def_en: A person who has a child or children.

examples.sentence: A single parent often faces many challenges in life.
examples.translation_zh: 单亲父母在生活中常常面临许多挑战。

examples.sentence: Different cultures have various approaches to parenting styles.
examples.translation_zh: 不同文化对育儿方式有不同的看法。

examples.sentence: Teachers organize parent meetings to discuss student progress.
examples.translation_zh: 老师组织家长会议来讨论学生的进展。

anything.def_en: Used to refer to any object, event, or situation.

examples.sentence: Is there anything else you want to tell me?
examples.translation_zh: 还有什么别的你想告诉我的吗？

examples.sentence: I can help you with anything at all if needed.
examples.translation_zh: 如果需要，我可以帮你处理任何事情。

examples.sentence: They will explore anything possible to solve the problem.
examples.translation_zh: 他们将探索所有可能解决这个问题的方法。

already.def_en: Before the present time; by this time.

examples.sentence: I have already finished my report for work.
examples.translation_zh: 我已经完成了我的工作报告。

examples.sentence: Have you already seen that movie this weekend?
examples.translation_zh: 你这个周末已经看过那部电影了吗？

examples.sentence: The results are already known to the research community.
examples.translation_zh: 这些结果已经为研究界所知。

speak.def_en: To say words in a particular language or manner.

examples.sentence: People in this city often speak English to tourists.
examples.translation_zh: 这个城市的人经常对游客讲英语。

examples.sentence: Experts will speak at the conference about new research.
examples.translation_zh: 专家将在会议上讲述新研究。

examples.sentence: You should speak your mind during the team meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该在团队会议上直言不讳。

read.def_en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written text.

examples.sentence: I usually read a book before going to sleep.
examples.translation_zh: 我通常在睡觉前阅读一本书。

examples.sentence: She reads the news every morning to stay informed.
examples.translation_zh: 她每天早上阅读新闻以保持了解。

examples.sentence: He read an article about climate change in class.
examples.translation_zh: 他在课堂上阅读了一篇关于气候变化的文章。

door.def_en: A movable barrier for opening and closing an entrance.

examples.sentence: She forgot to open the door for her friend.
examples.translation_zh: 她忘了给朋友打开门。

examples.sentence: Please remember to close the door when you leave.
examples.translation_zh: 请记得在离开时关上门。

examples.sentence: Students often knock on the door before entering the classroom.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们通常在进教室前敲门。

office.def_en: A room or building where work is done.

examples.sentence: Many companies decide to open an office in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司决定在城市开设办公室。

examples.sentence: She ordered new office supplies for her team today.
examples.translation_zh: 她今天为她的团队订购了新的办公用品。

examples.sentence: Students often have an office meeting with their teachers.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们经常与老师进行办公室会议。

examples.sentence: Everyone likes to be around a kind person.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都喜欢和善良的人在一起。

examples.sentence: Often, another person can help solve the problem.
examples.translation_zh: 通常，另一个人可以帮助解决这个问题。

examples.sentence: A young person should always pursue their dreams.
examples.translation_zh: 年轻人应该时刻追求自己的梦想。

health.def_en: A state of physical and mental well-being.

examples.sentence: Maintaining good mental health is very important for everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 保持良好的心理健康对每个人都非常重要。

examples.sentence: The government is investing more in health care services for citizens.
examples.translation_zh: 政府在公民的医疗服务上投入更多资金。

examples.sentence: Many companies offer health benefits to attract new employees.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司提供健康福利来吸引新员工。

sure.def_en: Free from doubt; confident about something.

examples.sentence: I am sure about that decision we made yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 我对我们昨天做出的决定很确定。

examples.sentence: Being sure of yourself can help you succeed at work.
examples.translation_zh: 自信能帮助你在工作中取得成功。

examples.sentence: Please make sure to submit your assignment on time.
examples.translation_zh: 请确保及时提交作业。

spend.def_en: To use money or time to buy or do something.

examples.sentence: We often spend money on groceries each week.
examples.translation_zh: 我们每周常常花钱买杂货。

examples.sentence: Employees can spend time on training and development.
examples.translation_zh: 员工可以花时间进行培训和发展。

examples.sentence: Students should spend time on their homework every day.
examples.translation_zh: 学生每天应该花时间做作业。

grow.def_en: To increase in size, amount, or degree.

examples.sentence: Children grow up quickly in their early years.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们在早期快速成长。

examples.sentence: Many farmers grow plants for food every season.
examples.translation_zh: 许多农民每个季节种植植物供食用。

examples.sentence: He works out to grow stronger and healthier every day.
examples.translation_zh: 他每天锻炼以变得更强壮，更健康。

open.def_en: To allow access or to make available.

examples.sentence: He will open the door for his friend.
examples.translation_zh: 他会为他的朋友打开门。

examples.sentence: You should open a book to learn more.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该打开一本书来了解更多。

examples.sentence: The park will open to the public next week.
examples.translation_zh: 公园将于下周对公众开放。

reason.def_en: A cause or explanation for something that happens.

examples.sentence: Students often ask for the main reason behind their grades.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们经常询问他们成绩背后的主要原因。

examples.sentence: She told me the reason why she was late yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 她告诉我她昨天迟到的原因。

examples.sentence: We should consider other options for this reason.
examples.translation_zh: 因此，我们应该考虑其他选择。

morning.def_en: The early part of the day, usually before noon.

examples.sentence: Good morning, I hope you slept well last night.
examples.translation_zh: 早上好，我希望你昨晚睡得好。

examples.sentence: He always arrives at the office in the early morning.
examples.translation_zh: 他总是在早晨很早到达办公室。

examples.sentence: This morning, the weather was surprisingly warm and sunny.
examples.translation_zh: 今天早上，天气出奇地温暖和阳光明媚。

party.def_en: A social gathering of people for enjoyment or celebration.

examples.sentence: Many friends attended her birthday party last weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 很多朋友上周末参加了她的生日聚会。

examples.sentence: The political party announced its candidate for the election.
examples.translation_zh: 这个政党宣布了其候选人。

examples.sentence: We are planning a dance party for the school festival.
examples.translation_zh: 我们正在为学校节日计划一个舞会。

programme.def_en: A plan of action or schedule for events.

examples.sentence: Many schools offer special education programmes for students.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学校为学生提供特殊教育方案。

examples.sentence: I enjoy watching a cooking TV programme every weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢每个周末看烹饪节目。

examples.sentence: The team is developing a new work programme for the project.
examples.translation_zh: 团队正在为该项目制定新的工作计划。

girl.def_en: A female child or young woman.

examples.sentence: Her little girl loves to play with dolls.
examples.translation_zh: 她的小女孩喜欢玩洋娃娃。

examples.sentence: Teenage girls often face many challenges in school.
examples.translation_zh: 青少女在学校常常面临许多挑战。

examples.sentence: She invited her girl friends to the party.
examples.translation_zh: 她邀请了她的女朋友们参加聚会。

walk.def_en: To move by putting one foot in front of the other.

examples.sentence: Many people take a walk after dinner every day.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人每天晚餐后都会散步。

examples.sentence: Children often walk to school if it is nearby.
examples.translation_zh: 如果学校在附近，孩子们经常步行上学。

examples.sentence: Visitors love to walk in the park during springtime.
examples.translation_zh: 游客们喜欢在春天的时候在公园里散步。

low.def_en: Having a small distance from the ground or base.

examples.sentence: Many people look for low prices when shopping.
examples.translation_zh: 购物时，很多人寻找低价格。

examples.sentence: The experiment showed low levels of contamination in the water.
examples.translation_zh: 实验显示水中的污染水平很低。

examples.sentence: I often feel low energy in the morning before breakfast.
examples.translation_zh: 我早上不吃早餐时常感到精力低下。

early.def_en: Before the expected or usual time; occurring soon.

examples.sentence: I like to go jogging in the early morning.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢在清晨去慢跑。

examples.sentence: The research is still in the early stages of development.
examples.translation_zh: 这项研究仍处于早期发展阶段。

examples.sentence: They received an early warning about the upcoming storm.
examples.translation_zh: 他们提前收到即将来临的风暴警报。

food.def_en: Substance consumed for nutritional support and energy.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy eating junk food for quick meals.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人喜欢吃快餐食物，方便快捷。

examples.sentence: Fast food restaurants are very popular in big cities.
examples.translation_zh: 快餐店在大城市里非常受欢迎。

examples.sentence: Eating healthy food is important for maintaining good health.
examples.translation_zh: 吃健康食品对保持良好的健康很重要。

moment.def_en: A very brief period of time.

examples.sentence: I am busy at the moment with my homework.
examples.translation_zh: 我现在正忙着做作业。

examples.sentence: In that moment, everything changed for the community.
examples.translation_zh: 在那一刻，社区的一切都发生了变化。

examples.sentence: Graduation is a defining moment in many students' lives.
examples.translation_zh: 毕业是许多学生生活中的一个重要时刻。

air.def_en: The invisible gas surrounding the Earth.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy walking in fresh air every morning.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢每天早晨在新鲜空气中散步。

examples.sentence: The politician's speech was full of hot air and no facts.
examples.translation_zh: 这位政治家的演讲充满了空话，没有事实。

examples.sentence: We need to improve air quality for the city's health.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要改善城市的空气质量，以保障健康。

enough.def_en: Sufficient in quantity, degree, or size for a purpose.

examples.sentence: You are good enough to win this competition.
examples.translation_zh: 你足够优秀，可以赢得这场比赛。

examples.sentence: We should have enough food for the entire week.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该有足够的食物，能吃整个星期。

examples.sentence: I need enough time to complete this project.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要足够的时间来完成这个项目。

across.def_en: From one side to the other of something.

examples.sentence: Children often go across the street after school.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们通常在放学后过马路。

examples.sentence: Many tourists travel across the country every summer.
examples.translation_zh: 许多游客每年夏天横穿全国。

examples.sentence: She can easily look across the room and see him.
examples.translation_zh: 她能轻松地从房间一边看到他。

remember.def_en: To have an image or idea in the mind again.

examples.sentence: Students must remember the details for the exam.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须记住考试的细节。

examples.sentence: My friends always remember my birthday every year.
examples.translation_zh: 我的朋友们每年都会记住我的生日。

examples.sentence: Don't forget to remember the rules during the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 在会议期间不要忘记记住规则。

teacher.def_en: A person who helps students learn.

examples.sentence: Many students love their classroom teachers very much.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生非常喜欢他们的课堂教师。

examples.sentence: A language teacher can help you improve your speaking skills.
examples.translation_zh: 语言教师可以帮助你提高口语能力。

examples.sentence: Music teachers inspire students to appreciate different genres.
examples.translation_zh: 音乐教师激励学生欣赏不同的音乐风格。

foot.def_en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle.

examples.sentence: Foot traffic has increased in the shopping area recently.
examples.translation_zh: 最近，购物区的客流量增加了。

examples.sentence: We prefer to explore the city on foot during our trips.
examples.translation_zh: 我们喜欢在旅行中步行探索城市。

examples.sentence: They camped at the foot of the mountain last weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 他们上周末在山脚下露营。

boy.def_en: A young male person, usually a child or teenager.

examples.sentence: The boy enjoys playing soccer with his friends.
examples.translation_zh: 这个男孩喜欢和朋友们踢足球。

examples.sentence: Young boys often like to explore the outdoors together.
examples.translation_zh: 小男孩们通常喜欢一起探索户外。

examples.sentence: Many boy's toys are designed to encourage creativity and fun.
examples.translation_zh: 许多男孩玩具旨在激发创造力和乐趣。

second.def_en: The ordinal number following the first; a unit of time.

examples.sentence: I bought a second hand book at the market.
examples.translation_zh: 我在市场上买了一本二手书。

examples.sentence: She finished in second place in the competition yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 她昨天在比赛中获得了第二名。

examples.sentence: He tried it for the second time and succeeded.
examples.translation_zh: 他第二次尝试，成功了。

able.def_en: Having the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something.

examples.sentence: She is able to finish her homework quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 她能够快速完成作业。

examples.sentence: They are finally able to travel abroad this summer.
examples.translation_zh: 他们终于能够在这个夏天出国旅行。

examples.sentence: He is not able to walk after the accident.
examples.translation_zh: 他在事故后无法行走。

maybe.def_en: Used to express uncertainty or possibility.

examples.sentence: We can go to the park, maybe next week.
examples.translation_zh: 我们可以去公园，也许下周。

examples.sentence: I have a new project, maybe you'll like it.
examples.translation_zh: 我有一个新项目，也许你会喜欢。

examples.sentence: Experts say maybe it's time for a change.
examples.translation_zh: 专家表示，也许是时候改变了。

age.def_en: The length of time a person or thing has existed.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy their life in old age.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人享受他们的老年生活。

examples.sentence: There is an age limit for applying to this program.
examples.translation_zh: 申请这个项目有年龄限制。

examples.sentence: The stone age marks the beginning of human development.
examples.translation_zh: 石器时代标志着人类发展的开始。

everything.def_en: All things; all that exists or occurs.

examples.sentence: You can find everything you need in this store.
examples.translation_zh: 你可以在这家商店找到你需要的一切。

examples.sentence: People believe that everything happens for a reason in life.
examples.translation_zh: 人们相信生活中一切发生都是有原因的。

examples.sentence: With hard work, everything is possible for students.
examples.translation_zh: 只要努力，学生们可以做到一切。

love.def_en: A strong feeling of deep affection or attachment.

examples.sentence: She has a strong love for her family.
examples.translation_zh: 她对家庭有很深的爱。

examples.sentence: Many people love their jobs and feel fulfilled.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人热爱自己的工作，感到满足。

examples.sentence: A love of learning helps students succeed in school.
examples.translation_zh: 对学习的热爱帮助学生在学校取得成功。

music.def_en: Art form of organized sounds and silence, often with rhythm.

examples.sentence: She loves to play music while cooking dinner.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢在做晚餐时播放音乐。

examples.sentence: Many people listen to music while working on projects.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人在做项目时听音乐。

examples.sentence: We enjoyed the live music at the festival last night.
examples.translation_zh: 我们昨晚在节日上享受了现场音乐。

wait.def_en: To remain in place until an expected event occurs.

examples.sentence: I usually wait for the bus in the morning.
examples.translation_zh: 我通常在早上等公交车。

examples.sentence: You must wait patiently for your turn during the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 在会议中，你必须耐心等候轮到你。

examples.sentence: Let's wait and see what happens next week.
examples.translation_zh: 让我们等着看下周会发生什么。

die.def_en: To cease living or existing; to pass away.

examples.sentence: Many people wish to not die young in life.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人希望不在年轻时去世。

examples.sentence: He died of cancer last year after a long battle.
examples.translation_zh: 他去年因长时间与癌症斗争而去世。

examples.sentence: Several people died in an accident on the highway.
examples.translation_zh: 高速公路上发生事故，几人去世。

send.def_en: To cause to go or be taken to a destination.

examples.sentence: I will send an email to the team today.
examples.translation_zh: 我今天会给团队发送一封邮件。

examples.sentence: She sends a message to her friend every day.
examples.translation_zh: 她每天都给朋友发送消息。

examples.sentence: They sent a letter to invite us to the party.
examples.translation_zh: 他们寄了一封信邀请我们参加派对。

build.def_en: To create or construct something, often a physical structure.

examples.sentence: Many families want to build a house together.
examples.translation_zh: 许多家庭想一起建造一所房子。

examples.sentence: Students need to build new skills for their future.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要为他们的未来建立新技能。

examples.sentence: Companies should build strong relationships with their clients.
examples.translation_zh: 公司应该与客户建立良好的关系。

expect.def_en: To regard something as likely to happen.

examples.sentence: We expect to see many visitors at the festival.
examples.translation_zh: 我们期望在节日里看到很多游客。

examples.sentence: Scientists expect results from the latest experiment soon.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家们期望很快能得到最新实验的结果。

examples.sentence: Employees expect changes in the company policies next month.
examples.translation_zh: 员工们期望下个月公司政策会有变化。

stay.def_en: To remain in a place or condition for a period.

examples.sentence: Many people try to stay healthy by exercising regularly.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人通过定期锻炼来保持健康。

examples.sentence: During the storm, we decided to stay at home all day.
examples.translation_zh: 在暴风雨期间，我们决定整天待在家里。

examples.sentence: Employees must stay connected with their teams via email.
examples.translation_zh: 员工必须通过电子邮件与他们的团队保持联系。

market.def_en: A place where goods and services are bought and sold.

examples.sentence: They decided to visit the open market nearby this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 他们决定这个周末去附近的集市逛逛。

examples.sentence: The company conducted market research to understand customer needs.
examples.translation_zh: 公司进行了市场调研，以了解顾客的需求。

examples.sentence: Investors are worried about changes in the stock market today.
examples.translation_zh: 投资者对今天股市的变化感到担忧。

plan.def_en: A detailed proposal for doing something.

examples.sentence: I need to create a study plan for next week.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要为下周制定学习计划。

examples.sentence: She wrote a business plan for her new company.
examples.translation_zh: 她为她的新公司写了一份商业计划。

examples.sentence: They discussed their travel plans for the summer vacation.
examples.translation_zh: 他们讨论了暑假的旅行计划。

cut.def_en: To divide something into pieces or sections.

examples.sentence: Companies need to cut costs to stay profitable.
examples.translation_zh: 公司需要削减成本以保持盈利。

examples.sentence: We must cut down on waste to protect the planet.
examples.translation_zh: 我们必须减少浪费以保护地球。

examples.sentence: She was cut off during the phone call yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 她在昨天的电话中被切断了。

the.def_en: Used before a noun to specify something.

examples.sentence: The sun rises in the east every morning.
examples.translation_zh: 每天早上，太阳从东边升起。

examples.sentence: Many important events are in the news today.
examples.translation_zh: 今天有许多重要事件在新闻中。

examples.sentence: Choosing the best option requires careful consideration.
examples.translation_zh: 选择最佳选项需要仔细考虑。

they.def_en: Used to refer to a group of people or things.

examples.sentence: They say that exercise is important for health.
examples.translation_zh: 他们说，锻炼对健康很重要。

examples.sentence: In the study, they agree on the need for more research.
examples.translation_zh: 在研究中，他们一致认为需要更多的研究。

examples.sentence: If they finish the project early, we can celebrate.
examples.translation_zh: 如果他们提前完成项目，我们可以庆祝。

we.def_en: A pronoun used by speakers to refer to themselves and others.

examples.sentence: We need to talk about our plans for the weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要谈谈周末的计划。

examples.sentence: If we work together, we can finish this project faster.
examples.translation_zh: 如果我们合作，就能更快完成这个项目。

examples.sentence: Students believe we can improve our learning environment.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们相信我们可以改善学习环境。

at.def_en: Used to indicate a specific location or time.

examples.sentence: She is currently at home with her family.
examples.translation_zh: 她现在和家人在家里。

examples.sentence: I will be at work by 9 AM tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 我明天会在工作地点，九点之前。

examples.sentence: The city is quiet at the moment after the storm.
examples.translation_zh: 风暴过后，城市此刻很安静。

my.def_en: Belonging to the speaker or writer.

examples.sentence: All my friends are coming to the party.
examples.translation_zh: 我所有的朋友都要来参加聚会。

examples.sentence: I forgot to finish my homework last night.
examples.translation_zh: 我昨晚忘记完成我的作业了。

examples.sentence: In my opinion, this movie is very interesting.
examples.translation_zh: 在我看来，这部电影非常有趣。

them.def_en: Used to refer to people or things previously mentioned.

examples.sentence: You should spend more time with them.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该多花时间和他们在一起。

examples.sentence: Teachers must help them understand the material.
examples.translation_zh: 老师必须帮助他们理解材料。

examples.sentence: Please tell them about the meeting tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 请告诉他们明天的会议。

like.def_en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable.

examples.sentence: Many people like football during the summer.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人夏天喜欢踢足球。

examples.sentence: This painting looks like a famous artwork from history.
examples.translation_zh: 这幅画看起来像一幅著名的历史艺术品。

examples.sentence: We need to find a solution like this for our project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要为我们的项目找到像这样的解决方案。

another.def_en: One more; an additional person or thing.

examples.sentence: We need another example to explain this topic.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要另一个例子来解释这个主题。

examples.sentence: She asked for another chance to prove herself.
examples.translation_zh: 她请求再给她一次证明自己的机会。

examples.sentence: Let's discuss this matter on another day.
examples.translation_zh: 让我们改天再讨论这个问题。

many.def_en: A large number of people or things.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy going to the beach in summer.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢在夏天去海滩。

examples.sentence: Students often ask many questions during the lesson.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们上课时常常会问很多问题。

examples.sentence: There are many reasons for choosing this career path.
examples.translation_zh: 选择这条职业道路有很多原因。

after.def_en: At a time later than a specified time or event.

examples.sentence: She plays soccer after school with her friends.
examples.translation_zh: 放学后，她和朋友们踢足球。

examples.sentence: We will discuss the project further after the meeting ends.
examples.translation_zh: 会议结束后，我们将进一步讨论这个项目。

examples.sentence: The students will write their essays after that lesson.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们将在那节课后写他们的作文。

or.def_en: Used to indicate a choice between alternatives.

examples.sentence: Would you like tea yes or no?
examples.translation_zh: 你想喝茶吗，想还是不想？

examples.sentence: We can choose either this or that option for the project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们可以为这个项目选择这个或那个选项。

examples.sentence: You can study either history or geography this semester.
examples.translation_zh: 这个学期你可以学习历史或地理。

few.def_en: Not many in number; a small quantity.

examples.sentence: Few people came to the meeting yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 昨天，来参加会议的人很少。

examples.sentence: There are few options available for this project.
examples.translation_zh: 这个项目可供选择的选项很少。

examples.sentence: The report had few details about the incident.
examples.translation_zh: 报告中关于事件的细节很少。

each.def_en: Used to refer to every one of two or more people or things.

examples.sentence: Teachers help each student with their learning needs.
examples.translation_zh: 老师帮助每个学生满足他们的学习需求。

examples.sentence: Each person should take responsibility for their actions.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都应该对自己的行为负责。

examples.sentence: The report is published each day to keep people updated.
examples.translation_zh: 该报告每天发布，以便让人们保持更新。

let.def_en: To allow someone to do something or to happen.

examples.sentence: Please let me know your decision soon.
examples.translation_zh: 请尽快让我知道你的决定。

examples.sentence: Sometimes, you must let it go and move on.
examples.translation_zh: 有时候，你必须放下它，继续前进。

examples.sentence: Let us pray for peace and understanding.
examples.translation_zh: 让我们为和平与理解祈祷。

during.def_en: At a time when something occurs.

examples.sentence: We discussed the project during the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在会议期间讨论了这个项目。

examples.sentence: They travel to Europe during the summer every year.
examples.translation_zh: 他们每年夏季去欧洲旅行。

examples.sentence: Guests arrived late during the ceremony last night.
examples.translation_zh: 昨晚，客人在仪式期间迟到了。

water.def_en: A clear liquid essential for life, often consumed.

examples.sentence: Children should drink enough water every day.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们每天应该喝足够的水。

examples.sentence: The city improved its water supply system recently.
examples.translation_zh: 这座城市最近改善了水供应系统。

examples.sentence: Scientists study the effects of water pollution on wildlife.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家研究水污染对野生动物的影响。

though.def_en: In spite of the fact that; however.

examples.sentence: I went for a run, though it was raining.
examples.translation_zh: 我去跑步，尽管下雨了。

examples.sentence: She passed the exam, though he tried hard.
examples.translation_zh: 他努力了，尽管她通过了考试。

examples.sentence: The project is on time, though it seems difficult.
examples.translation_zh: 这个项目按时完成，尽管看起来很难。

until.def_en: Up to the point in time or event.

examples.sentence: I will wait here until the end of the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 我会在这里等，直到会议结束。

examples.sentence: You need to submit the report until tomorrow morning.
examples.translation_zh: 你需要在明天早上之前提交报告。

examples.sentence: Students do not learn math until they are older.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们要等到年纪大些才学数学。

stop.def_en: To cause something to cease moving or operating.

examples.sentence: Many people want to stop smoking for good.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人想要彻底戒烟。

examples.sentence: Please stop the car at the next traffic light.
examples.translation_zh: 请在下一个红绿灯处停车。

examples.sentence: He decided to stop working at the company.
examples.translation_zh: 他决定停止在公司工作。

sit.def_en: To rest in a position with the body supported by the buttocks.

examples.sentence: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.
examples.translation_zh: 请坐下，放松自己。

examples.sentence: We should sit together to discuss the project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该坐在一起讨论这个项目。

examples.sentence: Students must sit quietly during the test.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在考试期间必须安静坐着。

buy.def_en: Obtain in exchange for payment or to acquire.

examples.sentence: We need to buy a ticket for the concert.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要买一张音乐会的票。

examples.sentence: She usually buys groceries every Saturday afternoon.
examples.translation_zh: 她通常在每个星期六下午买菜。

examples.sentence: He decided to buy a gift for her birthday.
examples.translation_zh: 他决定买一份礼物给她的生日。

serve.def_en: To provide assistance or perform duties for someone.

examples.sentence: Restaurants usually serve food at lunch and dinner.
examples.translation_zh: 餐厅通常在午餐和晚餐时提供食物。

examples.sentence: These tools serve a purpose in enhancing student learning.
examples.translation_zh: 这些工具在提高学生学习方面起到作用。

examples.sentence: This meeting will serve as a reminder of our goals.
examples.translation_zh: 这次会议将提醒我们目标。

fall.def_en: A season between summer and winter; to drop down.

examples.sentence: The leaves fall from the trees in autumn.
examples.translation_zh: 秋天，树叶从树上掉落。

examples.sentence: Sometimes, I fall asleep while reading a book.
examples.translation_zh: 有时，我在看书时会睡着。

examples.sentence: Our project may fall short of the deadline.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的项目可能无法按时完成。

college.def_en: An institution for higher education and academic degrees.

examples.sentence: Many students choose to attend community college first.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生选择先上社区大学。

examples.sentence: She is taking college courses online this semester.
examples.translation_zh: 这学期她正在修读在线大学课程。

examples.sentence: Having a college degree can help you find a job.
examples.translation_zh: 拥有大学学位可以帮助你找到工作。

examples.sentence: I would like to invite someone else to the party.
examples.translation_zh: 我想邀请其他人参加聚会。

examples.sentence: We need to discuss this with someone important in the company.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要和公司里的重要人士讨论这个。

examples.sentence: It is hard to find someone who understands this topic.
examples.translation_zh: 找到一个理解这个主题的人很困难。

six.def_en: The number after five and before seven.

examples.sentence: My daughter is six years old this month.
examples.translation_zh: 我女儿这个月六岁了。

examples.sentence: He scored six times in the final match.
examples.translation_zh: 他在决赛中进了六个球。

examples.sentence: The project will take six weeks to complete.
examples.translation_zh: 这个项目需要六周完成。

class.def_en: A group of students learning together.

examples.sentence: Students must follow the class schedule every semester.
examples.translation_zh: 学生每学期必须遵循课程表。

examples.sentence: Teachers help students when they are in class.
examples.translation_zh: 老师在课堂上帮助学生。

examples.sentence: I decided to take a class on professional writing.
examples.translation_zh: 我决定参加职业写作课程。

suggest.def_en: Propose an idea or plan for consideration.

examples.sentence: Teachers often suggest that you study more for exams.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们常常建议你为考试多学习。

examples.sentence: We need to suggest a solution to this problem quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要迅速提出一个解决这个问题的方案。

examples.sentence: Researchers suggest improvements to the current technology.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员建议对当前技术进行改进。

behind.def_en: At the back or rear part of something.

examples.sentence: Many changes happen behind the scenes in our organization.
examples.translation_zh: 在我们组织中，许多变化是在幕后发生的。

examples.sentence: He left his old life behind when he moved.
examples.translation_zh: 他搬家时留下了旧生活。

examples.sentence: The project is behind schedule due to delays.
examples.translation_zh: 由于延误，该项目进度滞后。

raise.def_en: To increase the amount, level, or strength of something.

examples.sentence: We need to raise money for the new project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要为这个新项目筹集资金。

examples.sentence: Schools aim to raise awareness about environmental issues.
examples.translation_zh: 学校旨在提高对环境问题的认识。

examples.sentence: The teacher will raise questions during the discussion.
examples.translation_zh: 老师会在讨论中提出问题。

care.def_en: Concern for someone or something; feelings of interest.

examples.sentence: I will take care of the pets while you are away.
examples.translation_zh: 你不在时，我会照顾宠物。

examples.sentence: Many people care for their elderly parents at home.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在家照顾年迈的父母。

examples.sentence: He does not care about the project's deadline at all.
examples.translation_zh: 他完全不在乎这个项目的截止日期。

late.def_en: Occurring after the expected time or deadline.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy going out late at night.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人喜欢在晚上出去。

examples.sentence: Her late arrival caused a delay in the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 她的迟到导致会议延迟。

examples.sentence: The company announced a late payment fee policy.
examples.translation_zh: 公司宣布了迟付费用政策。

field.def_en: An area of study or interest; also, an open space.

examples.sentence: Many students choose a field of study they enjoy.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生选择他们喜欢的领域学习。

examples.sentence: She has to complete her field work this summer.
examples.translation_zh: 她必须在这个夏天完成实地工作。

examples.sentence: The class is going on a field trip next week.
examples.translation_zh: 班级下周要去一次实地考察。

hard.def_en: Not easy to do or accomplish; solid and firm.

examples.sentence: Everyone knows that hard work leads to success.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都知道，努力工作会带来成功。

examples.sentence: She had a hard time finding her keys this morning.
examples.translation_zh: 今天早上，她找钥匙时遇到了困难。

examples.sentence: The police found hard evidence to support their case.
examples.translation_zh: 警方找到了有力证据来支持他们的案件。

pass.def_en: To move past something or to succeed in a test.

examples.sentence: Many students hope to pass an exam this month.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生希望这个月能通过考试。

examples.sentence: People usually pass the time by watching TV.
examples.translation_zh: 人们通常通过看电视来打发时间。

examples.sentence: The government plans to pass a law soon.
examples.translation_zh: 政府计划很快通过一项法律。

else.def_en: In addition to what has been mentioned before.

examples.sentence: Do you need anything else from the store?
examples.translation_zh: 你还需要从商店里买其他东西吗？

examples.sentence: Someone else will take care of the reports today.
examples.translation_zh: 今天会有人处理这些报告。

examples.sentence: We can go somewhere else for dinner tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 今晚我们可以去别的地方吃晚餐。

sell.def_en: To exchange goods or services for money.

examples.sentence: They sell products at the local market every weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 他们每个周末在当地市场出售商品。

examples.sentence: The theater will sell tickets for the new play tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 剧院明天将出售新剧的票。

examples.sentence: Companies can sell shares to raise money for growth.
examples.translation_zh: 公司可以出售股份以筹集发展资金。

development.def_en: The process of growing or improving something.

examples.sentence: Economic development is important for our community's growth.
examples.translation_zh: 经济发展对我们社区的增长很重要。

examples.sentence: Child development affects their future learning and behavior.
examples.translation_zh: 儿童发展影响他们未来的学习和行为。

examples.sentence: She focuses on personal development to improve her skills.
examples.translation_zh: 她专注于个人发展以提高自己的技能。

themselves.def_en: Referring to the people mentioned earlier, as the subject.

examples.sentence: Children often play by themselves in the park.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们常常在公园里自己玩。

examples.sentence: They must decide for themselves what to do next.
examples.translation_zh: 他们必须自行决定接下来要做什么。

examples.sentence: Students need to find ways to express themselves creatively.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要找到创造性表达自己的方式。

report.def_en: A written or spoken account of something.

examples.sentence: Journalists often write a news report on current events.
examples.translation_zh: 记者们经常就时事撰写新闻报告。

examples.sentence: The team submitted a scientific report to the conference.
examples.translation_zh: 团队向会议提交了一份科学报告。

examples.sentence: Our company will publish the annual report next month.
examples.translation_zh: 我们公司将在下个月发布年度报告。

strong.def_en: Having great physical power or intensity.

examples.sentence: The scientist presented strong evidence for his theory.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家提出了他理论的强有力证据。

examples.sentence: I prefer strong coffee in the morning to wake up.
examples.translation_zh: 早上我喜欢喝浓咖啡来提神。

examples.sentence: Our team needs a strong leader to guide us through challenges.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队需要一个强有力的领导者来引导我们应对挑战。

along.def_en: In a line next to or parallel to something.

examples.sentence: We walk along the path every morning.
examples.translation_zh: 我们每天早上沿着小路走。

examples.sentence: Students go along with their teachers on trips.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们和老师们一起去旅行。

examples.sentence: I met many friends along the way.
examples.translation_zh: 我在途中遇到了许多朋友。

decide.def_en: Make a choice or reach a conclusion.

examples.sentence: She must decide what to do today.
examples.translation_zh: 她必须决定今天做什么。

examples.sentence: They need to decide whether to go to the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 他们需要决定是否参加会议。

examples.sentence: The teacher will decide on a date for the exam.
examples.translation_zh: 老师会决定考试的日期。

possible.def_en: Able to happen or be done; achievable.

examples.sentence: Researchers analyze the possible outcome of this experiment.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员分析了这个实验的可能结果。

examples.sentence: You should help others as far as possible.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该尽可能地帮助他人。

examples.sentence: Our team will make it possible to finish on time.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队会让按时完成成为可能。

heart.def_en: The organ that pumps blood through the body.

examples.sentence: She felt sad after her broken heart.
examples.translation_zh: 她在心碎后感到伤心。

examples.sentence: A heart attack can be very serious and life-threatening.
examples.translation_zh: 心脏病发作可能非常严重，威胁生命。

examples.sentence: He had a change of heart about moving to another city.
examples.translation_zh: 他改变了搬到另一个城市的想法。

light.def_en: A source of illumination or brightness.

examples.sentence: Light pollution affects the natural behavior of wildlife.
examples.translation_zh: 光污染影响野生动物的自然行为。

examples.sentence: She bought a new light bulb for the lamp.
examples.translation_zh: 她为台灯买了一个新的灯泡。

examples.sentence: A light year measures the distance light travels in one year.
examples.translation_zh: 光年是光一年内传播的距离。

wife.def_en: A married woman in relation to her spouse.

examples.sentence: My wife loves to cook dinner for us.
examples.translation_zh: 我的妻子喜欢为我们做晚餐。

examples.sentence: His wife supports him in his career choices.
examples.translation_zh: 他的妻子支持他的职业选择。

examples.sentence: In many cultures, a good wife is highly valued.
examples.translation_zh: 在许多文化中，贤妻备受尊重。

pull.def_en: To exert force on something to move it closer.

examples.sentence: She needs to pull a heavy box across the floor.
examples.translation_zh: 她需要把一个重箱子拖过地板。

examples.sentence: The officer asked him to pull the car over safely.
examples.translation_zh: 警察让他安全地把车停靠在一边。

examples.sentence: Researchers often pull information from various sources for their studies.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员常常从不同来源获取信息用于他们的研究。

mind.def_en: The element of a person that thinks and feels.

examples.sentence: Parents often tell kids to mind their own business.
examples.translation_zh: 父母常常告诉孩子不要管闲事。

examples.sentence: She decided to change her mind about the trip.
examples.translation_zh: 她决定改变对这次旅行的看法。

examples.sentence: You need to make up your mind by tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 你需要在明天之前做出决定。

free.def_en: Not under the control of others; without cost.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy their free time at home.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人喜欢在家里享受他们的自由时间。

examples.sentence: Students have free access to the library resources.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以自由访问图书馆的资源。

examples.sentence: You can start a free trial for this software today.
examples.translation_zh: 你今天可以开始这个软件的免费试用。

price.def_en: The amount of money required to purchase something.

examples.sentence: I checked the price tag on the dress.
examples.translation_zh: 我查看了连衣裙上的价格标签。

examples.sentence: The high price of gas is causing public concern.
examples.translation_zh: 汽油的高价格引发了公众的担忧。

examples.sentence: We expect a price increase in the next quarter.
examples.translation_zh: 我们预计下一个季度会有价格上涨。

hope.def_en: A feeling of expectation for a positive outcome.

examples.sentence: People often have hope for a better future.
examples.translation_zh: 人们常常对更美好的未来抱有希望。

examples.sentence: Countries hope for peace after the negotiations.
examples.translation_zh: 各国希望在谈判后能实现和平。

examples.sentence: She hopes to succeed in her new job.
examples.translation_zh: 她希望在新工作中获得成功。

son.def_en: A male child in relation to his parents.

examples.sentence: My son loves to play soccer with his friends.
examples.translation_zh: 我的儿子喜欢和朋友踢足球。

examples.sentence: He is known as a good son in the community.
examples.translation_zh: 他在社区里被认为是个好儿子。

examples.sentence: We celebrated my son's birthday with a big party.
examples.translation_zh: 我们为我儿子的生日举行了一场盛大的派对。

return.def_en: To go back to a place or person.

examples.sentence: She will return home after the trip.
examples.translation_zh: 她在旅行后会返回家里。

examples.sentence: I must return to work after lunch.
examples.translation_zh: 我午餐后必须返回工作。

examples.sentence: You need to return a book by next week.
examples.translation_zh: 你需要在下周之前归还这本书。

develop.def_en: To grow or cause to grow and become more mature.

examples.sentence: Employees need to develop new skills for their jobs.
examples.translation_zh: 员工需要发展新技能以适应工作。

examples.sentence: We should develop a plan for our vacation soon.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该尽快制定一个度假的计划。

examples.sentence: Students must develop good habits for studying effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须养成良好的学习习惯。

road.def_en: A way for vehicles or people to travel on.

examples.sentence: Many shops are located along the main road.
examples.translation_zh: 许多商店都位于主干道旁边。

examples.sentence: Traveling is easier on a paved road.
examples.translation_zh: 在铺好的道路上旅行更容易。

examples.sentence: The bumpy road made the journey uncomfortable for everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 崎岖的道路让每个人的旅程都很不舒服。

carry.def_en: To hold or support while moving from one place to another.

examples.sentence: She carries a bag when she goes shopping.
examples.translation_zh: 她去购物时携带一个包。

examples.sentence: Scientists carry out research to find new medicines.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家进行研究以寻找新药。

examples.sentence: He carries a torch for her despite their breakup.
examples.translation_zh: 尽管他们分手了，他仍然对她心存情感。

drive.def_en: To operate and control a vehicle.

examples.sentence: She drives a car to work every day.
examples.translation_zh: 她每天开车上班。

examples.sentence: Employees must drive safely while on business trips.
examples.translation_zh: 员工在出差时必须安全驾驶。

examples.sentence: Leaders drive the change in their organizations.
examples.translation_zh: 领导在他们的组织中推动变革。

arm.def_en: A limb of the body between the shoulder and the wrist.

examples.sentence: Raise your arms to stretch your muscles after exercise.
examples.translation_zh: 锻炼后，抬起手臂来拉伸肌肉。

examples.sentence: They had a fun arm wrestling competition during the break.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在休息时举行了有趣的手臂摔跤比赛。

examples.sentence: Teachers should arm the children with knowledge and skills.
examples.translation_zh: 老师应该用知识和技能武装孩子们。

break.def_en: To separate into pieces or interrupt continuity.

examples.sentence: She broke the news about the surprise party.
examples.translation_zh: 她公布了关于惊喜派对的消息。

examples.sentence: They broke the record for the fastest marathon.
examples.translation_zh: 他们打破了最快马拉松的记录。

examples.sentence: We must break down barriers to education access.
examples.translation_zh: 我们必须打破教育获取的障碍。

receive.def_en: To get something that is sent or given.

examples.sentence: She will receive a message from her friend today.
examples.translation_zh: 她今天会收到朋友的信息。

examples.sentence: Employees must receive information about the new policies.
examples.translation_zh: 员工必须接收到关于新政策的信息。

examples.sentence: Students can receive assistance from tutors after school hours.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在放学后可以获得辅导员的帮助。

true.def_en: In accordance with fact or reality; accurate.

examples.sentence: My grandfather told me a true story from his childhood.
examples.translation_zh: 我祖父给我讲述了他童年的真实故事。

examples.sentence: You will find true friends who support you in tough times.
examples.translation_zh: 你会发现真正的朋友在你困难时会支持你。

examples.sentence: The true meaning of art sometimes gets misunderstood by many.
examples.translation_zh: 艺术的真正含义有时会被许多人误解。

examples.sentence: I want to thank you for your help today.
examples.translation_zh: 我想感谢你今天的帮助。

examples.sentence: They thanked the team for their hard work on the project.
examples.translation_zh: 他们感谢团队在项目上的辛勤工作。

examples.sentence: We always thank God for our blessings and good fortune.
examples.translation_zh: 我们总是感谢上帝赐予的祝福和好运。

join.def_en: To connect or combine with something or someone.

examples.sentence: Many people want to join a club after school.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人想在放学后加入一个俱乐部。

examples.sentence: Employees will join together to solve the problem.
examples.translation_zh: 员工们会齐心协力解决这个问题。

examples.sentence: Countries join forces to tackle climate change.
examples.translation_zh: 各国联合起来应对气候变化。

building.def_en: A structure with a roof and walls, such as a house.

examples.sentence: They are building a house in the new neighborhood.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在新社区建造一座房子。

examples.sentence: We need more building materials for the project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要更多的建筑材料来完成这个项目。

examples.sentence: Many cities require building permits for new constructions.
examples.translation_zh: 许多城市对新建筑要求申请建筑许可证。

season.def_en: A division of the year based on changes in weather.

examples.sentence: Winter is the coldest season of the year.
examples.translation_zh: 冬天是一年中最冷的季节。

examples.sentence: She bought a season ticket for the football games.
examples.translation_zh: 她购买了足球比赛的季票。

examples.sentence: Farmers prepare for the growing season in spring.
examples.translation_zh: 农民在春天为生长季节做准备。

full.def_en: Containing as much as possible; not empty.

examples.sentence: Children are often full of energy in the morning.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们早上通常充满活力。

examples.sentence: I submitted the full report to my boss yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 我昨天把完整的报告提交给了我的老板。

examples.sentence: Students must give full attention during the lecture.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们必须在讲座期间全神贯注。

agree.def_en: To have the same opinion or belief as someone else.

examples.sentence: I always agree with my friends on movie choices.
examples.translation_zh: 我总是和朋友们在电影选择上意见一致。

examples.sentence: Students should agree on the topic for their project.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们应该就他们的项目主题达成一致。

examples.sentence: The company and workers agreed to the new terms of employment.
examples.translation_zh: 公司和员工同意新的雇佣条款。

wear.def_en: To have clothing or accessories on the body.

examples.sentence: I like to wear comfortable shoes when walking.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢在走路时穿舒适的鞋子。

examples.sentence: She usually wears a coat during winter months.
examples.translation_zh: 她通常在冬天穿外套。

examples.sentence: Many people wear makeup for special occasions.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人在特殊场合化妆。

pick.def_en: To select or take something from a group.

examples.sentence: I usually pick up groceries on my way home.
examples.translation_zh: 我通常在回家的路上买菜。

examples.sentence: Students can pick a book from the library today.
examples.translation_zh: 学生今天可以从图书馆挑一本书。

examples.sentence: Children love to pick flowers in the spring.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在春天摘花。

paper.def_en: A material for writing or printing on.

examples.sentence: You need to sign these paper documents today.
examples.translation_zh: 你今天需要签署这些文件。

examples.sentence: Always keep a paper trail for important transactions.
examples.translation_zh: 对重要交易一定要保留纸质凭证。

examples.sentence: Many stores now use paper bags instead of plastic ones.
examples.translation_zh: 现在许多商店使用纸袋而不是塑料袋。

whose.def_en: Belonging to or associated with which person.

examples.sentence: I found a book whose cover is colorful.
examples.translation_zh: 我找到了一本封面五颜六色的书。

examples.sentence: She visited a neighbor whose house is very old.
examples.translation_zh: 她拜访了一位邻居，那个邻居的房子很旧。

examples.sentence: He is an athlete whose team won the championship.
examples.translation_zh: 他是一名运动员，他的球队赢得了冠军。

ground.def_en: The solid surface of the Earth or land.

examples.sentence: Protests are happening on the ground across the country.
examples.translation_zh: 全国各地都发生了抗议活动。

examples.sentence: Children love to play on the ground outside.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在外面的地面上玩耍。

examples.sentence: The building must be at ground level for safety.
examples.translation_zh: 为了安全，建筑物必须位于地面高度。

form.def_en: A particular way in which something exists or appears.

examples.sentence: We need to form a team for this project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要为这个项目组建一个团队。

examples.sentence: Yoga is a great form of exercise for relaxation.
examples.translation_zh: 瑜伽是一种很好的放松锻炼方式。

examples.sentence: Please fill out a form before your appointment.
examples.translation_zh: 请在预约之前填写一张表格。

eat.def_en: To consume food or drink through the mouth.

examples.sentence: Many people eat breakfast before going to work.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在上班之前吃早餐。

examples.sentence: It is important to eat healthy foods every day.
examples.translation_zh: 每天吃健康的食物很重要。

examples.sentence: Kids often eat fast food after school activities.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们常常在课外活动后吃快餐。

star.def_en: A luminous point in the night sky.

examples.sentence: I saw several shooting stars last night.
examples.translation_zh: 我昨晚看到了几颗流星。

examples.sentence: She became a star athlete in high school.
examples.translation_zh: 她在高中成为了一名明星运动员。

examples.sentence: Our solar system is part of a star system.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的太阳系是一个恒星系统的一部分。

everyone.def_en: All people in a group or situation.

examples.sentence: Everyone knows the importance of staying healthy.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都知道保持健康的重要性。

examples.sentence: Students believe everyone should learn a second language.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们认为每个人都应该学习第二语言。

examples.sentence: Experts say everyone agrees on climate change issues.
examples.translation_zh: 专家表示每个人都同意气候变化的问题。

half.def_en: One of two equal parts of something.

examples.sentence: I will be back in half an hour.
examples.translation_zh: 我会在半小时后回来。

examples.sentence: The tickets are available at half price today.
examples.translation_zh: 今天票价打五折。

examples.sentence: She completes her tasks in half the time needed.
examples.translation_zh: 她完成任务的时间是所需时间的一半。

teach.def_en: To give instruction or knowledge to someone.

examples.sentence: Teachers often teach English to students every day.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们每天都教学生英语。

examples.sentence: Parents usually teach children important life skills.
examples.translation_zh: 父母通常教孩子重要的生活技能。

examples.sentence: He will teach a class on business management next week.
examples.translation_zh: 他下周将教授一门关于商业管理的课程。

easy.def_en: Not difficult; simple to understand or do.

examples.sentence: This language is easy to learn for beginners.
examples.translation_zh: 这门语言对初学者来说很容易学。

examples.sentence: The website provides easy access to research papers.
examples.translation_zh: 该网站提供对研究论文的便捷访问。

examples.sentence: Choosing this restaurant was an easy choice for dinner.
examples.translation_zh: 选择这家餐厅作为晚餐非常简单。

table.def_en: An item of furniture with a flat top and legs.

examples.sentence: We eat dinner at the dining table every night.
examples.translation_zh: 我们每天晚上在餐桌上吃晚饭。

examples.sentence: The table of contents helps readers find information quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 目录帮助读者快速找到信息。

examples.sentence: She plays table tennis with her friends on weekends.
examples.translation_zh: 她周末和朋友们打乒乓球。

street.def_en: A public road in a city or town.

examples.sentence: Many shops are located on the busy street.
examples.translation_zh: 许多商店都位于繁忙的街道上。

examples.sentence: The festival was held on the main street of the town.
examples.translation_zh: 节日在小镇的主街上举行。

examples.sentence: She walked carefully down the narrow street at night.
examples.translation_zh: 她在夜晚小心地走过狭窄的街道。

cover.def_en: To place something over or upon, to protect or conceal.

examples.sentence: I sent a cover letter with my job application.
examples.translation_zh: 我在求职申请中附上了求职信。

examples.sentence: Teachers should cover a variety of topics in class.
examples.translation_zh: 老师应该在课堂上涵盖多种主题。

examples.sentence: They agreed to cover the costs of the trip.
examples.translation_zh: 他们同意承担这次旅行的费用。

cost.def_en: The amount required to pay for something.

examples.sentence: Buying a new car can cost a lot of money.
examples.translation_zh: 买一辆新车可能要花很多钱。

examples.sentence: The cost of living continues to rise in many cities.
examples.translation_zh: 很多城市的生活成本持续上涨。

examples.sentence: Training programs often cost money for employees.
examples.translation_zh: 培训项目通常需要员工支付费用。

itself.def_en: Referring to the same entity as the subject.

examples.sentence: Learning by doing itself is important for students.
examples.translation_zh: 实践本身对学生很重要。

examples.sentence: This tool works by itself without help.
examples.translation_zh: 这个工具可以独立工作，无需帮助。

examples.sentence: The issue itself is more complex than it seems.
examples.translation_zh: 这个问题本身比看起来更复杂。

quite.def_en: To a certain extent; fairly or to a degree.

examples.sentence: This book is quite interesting for students.
examples.translation_zh: 这本书对于学生来说相当有趣。

examples.sentence: The weather is quite good today for a picnic.
examples.translation_zh: 今天天气非常适合野餐。

examples.sentence: There are quite a few errors in the report.
examples.translation_zh: 报告中有相当多的错误。

either.def_en: One of two options or choices available.

examples.sentence: You can choose either option for the project.
examples.translation_zh: 你可以选择这个项目的任一选项。

examples.sentence: I will be happy either way if you join us.
examples.translation_zh: 如果你加入我们，我无论如何都会很高兴。

examples.sentence: Demonstrators gathered on either side of the street.
examples.translation_zh: 示威者聚集在街道的任一侧。

picture.def_en: A representation of someone or something in visual form.

examples.sentence: I like to take a picture of my friends.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢给我的朋友们拍照。

examples.sentence: This photo picture reminds me of our vacation.
examples.translation_zh: 这张照片让我想起我们的假期。

examples.sentence: The picture gallery has many famous artworks.
examples.translation_zh: 这个画廊有许多著名的艺术作品。

piece.def_en: A part or portion of something larger.

examples.sentence: This dessert is a piece of cake to make.
examples.translation_zh: 这个甜点很容易制作。

examples.sentence: The museum has a beautiful piece of art.
examples.translation_zh: 博物馆里有一件美丽的艺术品。

examples.sentence: We need to piece together the project details.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要将项目细节整理在一起。

clear.def_en: Easy to perceive, understand, or interpret.

examples.sentence: Teachers provide a clear explanation of the topic.
examples.translation_zh: 老师对这个主题做了清晰的解释。

examples.sentence: The manager gave us clear guidelines for the project.
examples.translation_zh: 经理给了我们项目的清晰指导方针。

examples.sentence: Tomorrow promises clear skies for our picnic.
examples.translation_zh: 明天的野餐天气预报是晴空万里。

practice.def_en: Repetition of an activity to improve skill or performance.

examples.sentence: She has daily practice to learn the piano.
examples.translation_zh: 她每天练习学习钢琴。

examples.sentence: They run a successful medical practice in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在城市里经营着一家成功的医疗机构。

examples.sentence: Students must engage in academic practice to succeed.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们必须参与学术活动以取得成功。

wall.def_en: A vertical structure that defines and encloses an area.

examples.sentence: She painted the garden wall a bright blue.
examples.translation_zh: 她把花园的墙涂成了明亮的蓝色。

examples.sentence: He hit his head against the brick wall accidentally.
examples.translation_zh: 他不小心撞上了砖墙。

examples.sentence: They installed a soundproof wall in the recording studio.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在录音室里安装了一面隔音墙。

doctor.def_en: A person who treats illnesses and injuries.

examples.sentence: My family doctor is very caring and helpful.
examples.translation_zh: 我的家庭医生非常关心和乐于助人。

examples.sentence: You should see a doctor if you feel unwell.
examples.translation_zh: 如果你感到不舒服，你应该去看医生。

examples.sentence: She wants to become a medical doctor after finishing school.
examples.translation_zh: 她希望在完成学业后成为一名医学博士。

land.def_en: The solid part of the Earth's surface.

examples.sentence: Farmers use agricultural land to grow crops.
examples.translation_zh: 农民利用农田种植作物。

examples.sentence: Understanding land ownership is important for real estate agents.
examples.translation_zh: 了解土地所有权对房地产经纪人很重要。

examples.sentence: Many cities have vacant land for new parks and developments.
examples.translation_zh: 许多城市有空地可用于新公园和开发项目。

worker.def_en: A person who does a specific job to earn money.

examples.sentence: Many construction workers are working on the new building.
examples.translation_zh: 许多建筑工人正在新大楼上工作。

examples.sentence: Social workers help families find support and resources.
examples.translation_zh: 社会工作者帮助家庭找到支持和资源。

examples.sentence: Factory workers protested for better wages last week.
examples.translation_zh: 工人上周为更好的工资举行了抗议。

news.def_en: Information about recent events or happenings.

examples.sentence: Many people watch television for breaking news updates.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人通过电视获取突发新闻更新。

examples.sentence: I have good news about the job offer you wanted.
examples.translation_zh: 我有关于你想要的工作机会的好消息。

examples.sentence: Local news often covers events happening in the community.
examples.translation_zh: 地方新闻经常报道社区发生的事件。

computer.def_en: An electronic device for processing data and performing tasks.

examples.sentence: My personal computer is very fast and reliable.
examples.translation_zh: 我的个人电脑非常快且可靠。

examples.sentence: He installed new computer software to improve productivity.
examples.translation_zh: 他安装了新的计算机软件以提高生产力。

examples.sentence: A computer network connects multiple devices for communication.
examples.translation_zh: 计算机网络连接多个设备以进行通信。

examples.sentence: I always catch the bus at 8 AM.
examples.translation_zh: 我总是在早上八点乘公交车。

examples.sentence: She caught a cold last week and stayed home.
examples.translation_zh: 她上周感冒了，呆在家里。

examples.sentence: The teacher's story caught the students’ attention quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 老师的故事迅速吸引了学生的注意。

third.def_en: The ordinal number representing three in a sequence.

examples.sentence: She finished in third place in the race.
examples.translation_zh: 她在比赛中获得了第三名。

examples.sentence: Many children start third grade at age eight.
examples.translation_zh: 许多孩子在八岁时开始上三年级。

examples.sentence: The contract was signed by a third party as well.
examples.translation_zh: 合同也由第三方签署。

film.def_en: A series of moving images that tell a story.

examples.sentence: I love to watch a film every weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢每个周末看一部电影。

examples.sentence: The film festival showcases many international movies.
examples.translation_zh: 电影节展出了许多国际电影。

examples.sentence: They are producing a documentary film about climate change.
examples.translation_zh: 他们正在制作一部关于气候变化的纪录片。

draw.def_en: To make a mark or picture using a tool.

examples.sentence: Children like to draw pictures in their notebooks.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在他们的笔记本上绘画。

examples.sentence: The new policy will draw attention from the media.
examples.translation_zh: 新政策将引起媒体的关注。

examples.sentence: Researchers often draw a conclusion from their findings.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员通常会根据他们的发现得出结论。

tree.def_en: A tall plant with a trunk and branches.

examples.sentence: Many people grow fruit trees in their gardens.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人会在自家花园种植水果树。

examples.sentence: The tree trunk supports the branches and leaves above.
examples.translation_zh: 树干支撑着上面的树枝和树叶。

examples.sentence: A shade tree can provide relief from the hot sun.
examples.translation_zh: 遮阴树可以在炎热的阳光下提供庇荫。

baby.def_en: A very young human child, especially before walking.

examples.sentence: Friends organized a surprise baby shower for her.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友们为她策划了一个惊喜的婴儿派对。

examples.sentence: Many parents prefer homemade baby food for their infants.
examples.translation_zh: 许多父母更喜欢为他们的婴儿自制婴儿食品。

examples.sentence: A baby monitor helps parents keep an eye on their child.
examples.translation_zh: 婴儿监视器帮助父母关注他们的孩子。

hair.def_en: The fine strands that grow from the skin of the head.

examples.sentence: She has long hair that reaches her waist.
examples.translation_zh: 她的头发很长，直达腰部。

examples.sentence: Different hair colors can represent different cultures.
examples.translation_zh: 不同的头发颜色可以代表不同的文化。

examples.sentence: Choose a stylish hair style for your interview.
examples.translation_zh: 为你的面试选择一个时尚的发型。

nearly.def_en: Almost, but not completely or exactly.

examples.sentence: I go for a walk nearly every day.
examples.translation_zh: 我几乎每天都去散步。

examples.sentence: The project is nearly finished and ready for review.
examples.translation_zh: 这个项目几乎完成，可以进行审核。

examples.sentence: Nearly 100 people attended the town hall meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 几乎有100人参加了市政厅会议。

red.def_en: A primary color resembling the color of blood or fire.

examples.sentence: I bought a red apple from the market.
examples.translation_zh: 我在市场买了一个红色的苹果。

examples.sentence: The red flag warned of a dangerous situation ahead.
examples.translation_zh: 红色警告旗警告前方存在危险情况。

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy pasta with red sauce on top.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢在意大利面上加红色酱料。

window.def_en: An opening in a wall for light and air.

examples.sentence: I need to open the window for fresh air.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要打开窗户以通风。

examples.sentence: The store has a beautiful window display this season.
examples.translation_zh: 这家商店本季的橱窗布置很美。

examples.sentence: This is a window of opportunity for new projects.
examples.translation_zh: 这是一个新项目的机会窗口。

listen.def_en: To give attention to sound or to hear something.

examples.sentence: I listen to music during my free time.
examples.translation_zh: 我在空闲时间听音乐。

examples.sentence: Students must listen carefully during the lecture.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在讲座中必须认真听讲。

examples.sentence: She listens to the news every morning on the radio.
examples.translation_zh: 她每天早上在收音机上听新闻。

difficult.def_en: Not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

examples.sentence: Completing this project is a difficult task for everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 完成这个项目对每个人来说都是一项困难的任务。

examples.sentence: Choosing a college can be a difficult decision for students.
examples.translation_zh: 选择大学对学生来说可能是一个困难的决定。

examples.sentence: The teacher asked a difficult question during the exam.
examples.translation_zh: 老师在考试中问了一个困难的问题。

summer.def_en: The warmest season of the year.

examples.sentence: We are planning a summer vacation to the beach.
examples.translation_zh: 我们正在计划一个去海滩的夏季假期。

examples.sentence: This summer heat is making everyone uncomfortable outside.
examples.translation_zh: 这个夏季的炎热让外面每个人都很不舒服。

examples.sentence: Our town will host a summer festival next week.
examples.translation_zh: 我们镇下周将举行一个夏季节。

hundred.def_en: The number equal to ten times ten.

examples.sentence: He saved a hundred dollars for his vacation.
examples.translation_zh: 他为假期存了一百美元。

examples.sentence: About a hundred people attended the seminar last week.
examples.translation_zh: 上周，大约有一百人参加了研讨会。

examples.sentence: This process can be repeated a hundred times if needed.
examples.translation_zh: 如果需要，这个过程可以重复一百次。

brother.def_en: A male sibling or a close male friend.

examples.sentence: My brother likes to play video games every weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我哥哥每周末喜欢玩电子游戏。

examples.sentence: He is my younger brother and he studies hard.
examples.translation_zh: 他是我弟弟，学习很努力。

examples.sentence: An older brother often takes care of his younger siblings.
examples.translation_zh: 哥哥通常会照顾弟弟妹妹。

plant.def_en: A living organism that grows in soil or water.

examples.sentence: We should plant trees to help the planet.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该种树来帮助地球。

examples.sentence: The power plant provides electricity for the city.
examples.translation_zh: 发电厂为城市提供电力。

examples.sentence: Scientists discovered a new plant species in the rainforest.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家在热带雨林中发现了一种新的植物物种。

soon.def_en: In a short time; in the near future.

examples.sentence: I hope my friends will come soon to visit me.
examples.translation_zh: 我希望我的朋友们能很快来探望我。

examples.sentence: We will see you soon at the meeting tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 我们明天会议上很快就会见到你。

examples.sentence: They need to leave soon to catch their flight.
examples.translation_zh: 他们需要很快出发，以赶上他们的航班。

examples.sentence: She enjoys reading a short story before bed.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢在睡前读一篇短篇故事。

examples.sentence: Taking a short break helps improve focus during work.
examples.translation_zh: 短暂的休息有助于提高工作时的专注力。

examples.sentence: The committee created a short list of candidates for the position.
examples.translation_zh: 委员会为这个职位创建了一份候选人短名单。

examples.sentence: My sister loves her daughter very much.
examples.translation_zh: 我姐姐非常爱她的女儿。

examples.sentence: The teacher praised the daughter for her excellent work.
examples.translation_zh: 老师表扬了这位女儿的优异表现。

examples.sentence: A daughter was born to the royal family yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 王室昨天迎来了一个女儿。

single.def_en: Only one; not accompanied or joined by others.

examples.sentence: She is a single parent raising two children.
examples.translation_zh: 她是一位单身家长，抚养两个孩子。

examples.sentence: I bought a single ticket for the train to London.
examples.translation_zh: 我买了一张去伦敦的单程票。

examples.sentence: We should focus on a single point during the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在会议中应专注于一个要点。

letter.def_en: A written or printed message sent to someone.

examples.sentence: She decided to write a letter to her friend.
examples.translation_zh: 她决定给朋友写一封信。

examples.sentence: He found an old love letter in the drawer.
examples.translation_zh: 他在抽屉里发现了一封旧情书。

examples.sentence: Please submit a letter of recommendation with your application.
examples.translation_zh: 请在申请中提交推荐信。

husband.def_en: A male partner in a marriage or romantic relationship.

examples.sentence: My husband cooks dinner for our family every night.
examples.translation_zh: 我丈夫每晚为我们的家人做晚餐。

examples.sentence: The husband and wife duo started their own business together.
examples.translation_zh: 这对夫妻共同创办了自己的生意。

examples.sentence: He is considered a good husband by his friends.
examples.translation_zh: 他的朋友们认为他是个好丈夫。

colour.def_en: A property of objects determined by specific wavelengths of light.

examples.sentence: I like to wear my favorite colour every day.
examples.translation_zh: 我每天都喜欢穿我最喜欢的颜色。

examples.sentence: Bright colours make the festival more enjoyable for everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 鲜艳的颜色让这个节日更加令人愉快。

examples.sentence: The new office has a modern colour scheme that looks nice.
examples.translation_zh: 新办公室有一个现代的配色方案，看起来很好。

floor.def_en: The surface of a room where people walk.

examples.sentence: I need to clean the floor before guests arrive.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要在客人到来之前清理地板。

examples.sentence: Our office is located on the second floor of the building.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的办公室位于大楼的二楼。

examples.sentence: The restaurant has a beautiful wooden floor that shines.
examples.translation_zh: 这家餐厅有一块美丽的木地板，闪闪发光。

south.def_en: The direction opposite to north; one of the cardinal points.

examples.sentence: The park is located south of the river.
examples.translation_zh: 公园位于河的南边。

examples.sentence: South winds bring warmer temperatures in winter.
examples.translation_zh: 南风在冬天带来更温暖的气温。

examples.sentence: They plan to build a new office on the south side.
examples.translation_zh: 他们计划在南侧建一座新办公室。

thousand.def_en: The cardinal number equal to ten times one hundred.

examples.sentence: Thousands of people attended the event last weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 成千上万的人参加了上周末的活动。

examples.sentence: This restaurant is a thousand times better than the last one.
examples.translation_zh: 这家餐厅比上一家好了一千倍。

examples.sentence: He earned a thousand dollars for his freelance project.
examples.translation_zh: 他为自由职业项目赚了一千美元。

hospital.def_en: A place where sick or injured people receive treatment and care.

examples.sentence: We need to go to the hospital after the accident.
examples.translation_zh: 事故后我们需要去医院。

examples.sentence: She works at a hospital in the city as a nurse.
examples.translation_zh: 她在市里的医院工作，担任护士。

examples.sentence: Hospital admission can be stressful for many patients.
examples.translation_zh: 入院对许多病人来说可能很有压力。

fire.def_en: A rapid oxidation process producing heat and light.

examples.sentence: The fire alarm rang loudly in the building.
examples.translation_zh: 火警警报在大楼内大声响起。

examples.sentence: Teachers organized a fire drill for all students today.
examples.translation_zh: 老师今天为所有学生组织了消防演习。

examples.sentence: A fire outbreak occurred in the downtown area last night.
examples.translation_zh: 昨晚市中心发生了一起火灾。

future.def_en: Time that comes after the present.

examples.sentence: She shared her future plans with her friends.
examples.translation_zh: 她和朋友分享了她的未来计划。

examples.sentence: We must protect the environment for future generations.
examples.translation_zh: 我们必须为未来的世代保护环境。

examples.sentence: He is excited about his future job opportunities.
examples.translation_zh: 他对未来的工作机会感到兴奋。

myself.def_en: Used to refer to one's own person or self.

examples.sentence: I like to read books by myself at home.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢在家自己看书。

examples.sentence: Sometimes, I talk to myself when I'm thinking.
examples.translation_zh: 有时候，我会在思考时和自己说话。

examples.sentence: In college, I found myself interested in philosophy.
examples.translation_zh: 在大学里，我发现自己对哲学感兴趣。

wrong.def_en: Not correct or true; mistaken or inaccurate.

examples.sentence: She gave a wrong answer on the test yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 她昨天在考试中给出了错误的答案。

examples.sentence: Making a wrong decision can lead to serious problems.
examples.translation_zh: 做出错误的决定可能会导致严重的问题。
